title: discovery.py: Missing hop_limit upper bound validation allows negative hop counts
description: Line 131: actual_hops = INITIAL_HOP_LIMIT - rreq.hop_limit computes hop count from untrusted RREQ. If attacker sends RREQ with hop_limit > INITIAL_HOP_LIMIT, actual_hops becomes negative. This negative value is stored as hop_count and metric in RouteEntry (lines 137-138), corrupting route cache and breaking route selection that assumes non-negative hop counts.
close_reason: Fixed: Added max(0, ...) clamp to actual_hops calculation at line 134 of discovery.py to prevent negative hop counts when hop_limit exceeds INITIAL_HOP_LIMIT (e.g., expanding ring RREQs or malicious packets). Tests pass.
